customManagers.description: Chart.yaml appVersion is the real image pin: every chart ships image.tag: '' and the template falls back to .Chart.AppVersion. The built-in helm-values manager separately covers the values.yaml that DO pin a concrete tag: superset's embedded redis, zammad's embedded postgres/redis/memcached/elasticsearch and swarmcli-cd's git-sync sidecar (image: {repository, tag} blocks), plus ollama's model-preload init image (a bare `modelInitImage:` scalar, caught because helm-values' inline heuristic matches any key ending /image$/i). Charts with tag: '' extract a dep with no currentValue, which is non-actionable, so the default helm-values pattern needs no narrowing.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions bumps into one PR, keeping the pinned <sha> # <tag> form every workflow already uses. Replaces the dependabot group.

Coarse-tag databases. The tag IS the version series (postgres:18, mariadb:11.8) — the registry re-publishes it with patches, so the only update Renovate can see is a series change, and that is a DATA MIGRATION: postgres derives /var/lib/postgresql/<major>/docker from appVersion, and an existing volume initialised by the old server will not be read by the new one. Dashboard approval keeps it visible without ever auto-opening a PR.
prBodyNotes: **This is a database series upgrade, not a version bump.** Volumes initialised by the old server will not be read by the new one without an explicit dump/restore (or `pg_upgrade` / `mariadb-upgrade`). Before merging: bump the chart MINOR (not patch), document the migration in the chart README, and check `ci/legacy-major-values.yaml` still pins an older series so the previous layout stays covered.

packageRules.description: Services that own a schema or a static config: minor/patch flow as normal PRs, majors are breaking. Keycloak migrates the external DB schema; superset's init service runs `superset db upgrade` irreversibly; traefik v3->v4 breaks static config; redis RDB is forward-only.

The image of the bot that opens every other PR here. A Renovate major can drop config options and change defaults — including the ones this file relies on — and a broken bot fails silently, by simply not maintaining the pins any more. Majors get a deliberate click; minor/patch flow as normal PRs.

openclaw ships calver (2026.6.11), so docker versioning reports a new YEAR as a major. That is not a breaking-change signal — exempt it from the major gate above and let CI + e2e + minimumReleaseAge carry the risk.
Per-chart semantic commit scope, matching the repo's feat(redis):/fix(traefik): convention.
Merging a pin does not publish a chart — the chart version is a human judgement (an image patch can still warrant a chart minor), so releasing stays an explicit step.
prBodyNotes:
Merging this changes the chart's **default image** only. It does **not** publish a chart. Release it after merge:
```bash
gh workflow run release.yml -f chart=<chart> -f bump=patch
```
Prefer the dispatch over pushing tags by hand when releasing several charts at once: GitHub silently drops tag-push events beyond 3 tags per `git push`, which would leave some charts tagged but never published.
